framework.validation: Native Scala.js engine compiled from the inspected source; 11 scenarios, invalid-input checks and JSON round trip passed on 2026-09-12.

constraints.reason: ABIL is included in allowable losses before subtraction under 3(b)(ii).

constraints.rule: All records belong to one natural-person taxpayer and /return/taxYear; use separate graphs for other years and taxpayers.
/return/currency == CAD; convert foreign amounts under applicable section 261 rules before entry.
Enforce every non-null values list in this catalogue; XML String does not enforce a vocabulary.
Every inclusion/deduction has one posting destination in the core; domain-contract amounts are not additional postings.
Unset is unknown, never automatically zero or false. Explicit empty collections and explicit zero reviewed totals establish absence.
Core output is ordinary resident taxable-income arithmetic only; route non-residents, part-year residents, death and bankruptcy through reviewed special modules.
Do not expose core result until /review/coreReady is true; do not infer a final tax payable or refund.
